description: Lowest-priced product in each eligible Sense2 collection, ranked at minimum order, with market prices and qualifying quantities. Filter by collection or page using total and nextOffset.

collection.description: Optional collection name substring or slug, e.g. 'tote', 'conference', 'custom-tote-bags'

locale.description: en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP. Defaults to the endpoint host's market.

offset.description: Skip the first N entries (default 0) — use nextOffset from the previous page

name: get_cheapest_by_collection
